notes.title: Dev Blog #2: Ways to get around in Under a Rock
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Based on the recent announcement trailer, we thought it would be a great idea to cover a few of the traversal methods you saw, as well as the ones we haven’t shown yet.

While exploring the vibrant biomes of Under a Rock, you need to be able to think on your feet. Like when you first see a creature, even if they’re absolutely adorable, you need to be ready to react—whether that ends with you giving them a hug or, the more likely option, running for your life. While running is a quintessential part of getting around in any survival game, there may be times where going on foot just isn’t the best or even the preferred approach, and that’s where the variety of travel mechanics come into play.

Now let’s take a peek at those methods:
While some of these mechanics will be available to you as soon as you wash up on the beach, some will require you to craft items or tame creatures.


GLIDING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/0f2ab65ba843b5775bd9edf76dc9c31a9fc4d25c.gif
Soar through the air with your very own glider and experience the world from above by jumping off the highest mountain, or opt for something simpler by choosing the nearest rock. This one is an easy-to-learn, but hard-to-master mechanic.

[table]
    [tr]
        [td]Stamina use[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Fatigue drain[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Affected by weather[/td]
        [td]Yes, heavily[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Distance limited[/td]
        [td]Yes, based on stamina[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Has skill to level up[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Repairs needed[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Crafted[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Gliding through the air during a storm, although fun, might not be the best idea.


GRAPPLING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/efb4e115601946fac84fcf870475f71711ce4c9f.gif
This is a favorite of ours. We just had to have it, and it turned out to be amazingly good fun, even more fun than we expected it would be. You can grapple freely to any surface strong enough to support the grappling hook, meaning it will go straight through the leaves on a palm tree, but the trunk itself will work nicely.

    [tr]
        [td]Stamina use[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Fatigue drain[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Affected by weather[/td]
        [td]Yes, slightly[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Distance limited[/td]
        [td]Yes, based on stamina and grappling hook [/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Has skill to level up [/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Repairs needed [/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Crafted[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Grappling down can easily lead to unfortunate corpse runs. Unless, of course, you have chosen abilities that mitigate some of this high-velocity fall damage.


CLIMBING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/14dbad950a9dabd8a1a9af529f593126c8e6d7be.gif
Under a Rock would feel incomplete unless you could climb rocks, trees, the walls of your home—basically any surface that looks climbable.

This is free climbing at its finest. Up, down, sideways, diagonally, even around edges. Want those coconuts high up in the palm tree? Well, you can either climb up or chop it down, though should you do the latter, you won’t be getting any more coconuts from that tree.

[table]
    [tr]
        [td]Stamina use[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Fatigue drain[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Affected by weather[/td]
        [td]Yes, slightly[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Distance limited[/td]
        [td]Yes, based on stamina and tools[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Has skill to level up[/td]
        [td]Yes[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Repairs needed[/td]

    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Crafted[/td]
        [td]Only if tools are used[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

When you get to an edge, you will mantle onto the surface above. Going down works the same way, just in reverse, but only as long as you choose to go into climbing mode.


SWIMMING & DIVING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/fca14fdaeae0972760a7539cc756f5b66f3a7b60.gif
There are water surfaces to swim across and mysterious depths to explore while diving. Shipwrecks, enigmatic ruins, creatures, resources, and even underwater caves await.

RIDING CREATURES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/d169adeefdfb716f5927cfa7c7fadf781c838232.gif
Form a bond with creatures of your choice, be it a Snugget, a Dodo, a Bee, or one of the many other creatures that inhabit the island. Their speed, ability to carry, or even combat skills vary, so having multiple companions to choose from is a good idea.

Would you like to know more? Then make sure to follow us on social media and Discord, as we will be releasing longer gameplay footage of our travel mechanics over the coming weeks.

notes.title: Announcement Trailer, PC Gaming Show & Xbox Fanfest Live Stream, Publisher
notes.content:
The 30th of November has arrived, which means the time has come for us to share with you all what we teased a few weeks ago on social media. And that is our official announcement trailer!  

We had the honor to showcase it for the first time during the PC Gaming Show and at the Xbox Comi-Con Brazil Showcase, and we feel incredibly happy they invited us to be part of the show. 

In case you missed the trailer, or you want to rewatch it, you can check out our official trailer - it includes some additional gameplay footage - here:

[previewyoutube=V8PMRW5LfII;full][previewyoutube=V8PMRW5LfII;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
 

Trailer Creation 

It took a lot of hard work and several late-night brainstorming sessions from us dodos for this trailer to come to life, and we could not be happier with the result!  

We would like to share with you some of the early stages of our creative process in the form of concept art that was created and used for the story board: 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/87c09c3390ffe0c21e80ad354f302455e4e7b8d0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/7ed25e242ab1c8f37140d9a630e6e0a1eed157bf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/2d4ebea5ccd4544485d34dce0e94abdbbaed29d2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/b0385524336d916f0e6305da950befecd578dde3.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/6ff06f5abfe3bb9642d045e32c2c2c6b08248fda.jpg



Publisher 

We are also super excited to announce that we have partnered with Gameforge! We are thrilled about working with them and trust that having their support will help Under a Rock reach a broader audience.  

Considering our team is only 5 dodos strong, we're really glad to have their assistance with the marketing and business side of creating and publishing a game, which will allow us to focus on what our top priority has always been: making the game as great as it can be! 

With all of that said, we want to thank everyone for being a part of this journey.  

We truly couldn't have gotten to this point without you all, and we cannot wait to show you more of what we have in store.

notes.title: Dev Blog #1: Creatures and Base Building
notes.content:
Before we dive in, we wanted to take a moment to thank everyone in our growing community for the massive support you’ve given us so far. Whether this is your first time learning about our game or you’ve been with us from the start, your support is so greatly appreciated, and it continues to provide us, along with ample amounts of coffee, with the fuel we need to push through those challenging moments that come with developing a game. So, again, thank you very much!

With that said, if you’ve been around since we first showcased our game back in 2022, you’ll know that a lot has happened since then. It’s now been over a year, and we figured it was time to start providing you with some regular updates about the game’s development, not only to keep everyone aware of what’s going on, but also so we can give you a taste of what’s to come. Starting off with a recap of information that you may or may not be familiar with already.   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/9e479485eb1e6b2588a2a085e6aaa3b6f5f0258c.gif

CREATURES
One of the first things we wanted to talk about is... creatures! While we plan to have a wide assortment of them upon launch, and already have the 3D models for many, we thought we would take a moment to focus on just three of the incredible creatures that inhabit the world of Under a Rock and tell you a bit about what we’ve been doing to bring them to life. These being the Fluffypuff – a large, adorable bunny-like creature –, the Snugget – a cute sabretooth-hamster hybrid –, and our beloved Dodos – a long thought extinct creature, brought back to life in our game!

An important aspect of the development process for us is ensuring we are creating a world that feels alive through the behavior of its inhabitants, and because of this, we spend a lot of time working on the creature AI in situations both inside and outside of combat. Recently we focused on how these three creatures react to different weather events, for example lightning storms:


 Dodos will run around scared, or try to find bushes to hide in.
 Fluffypuffs will burrow and hide underground, and you can find the mounds of dirt they leave behind and watch them come out when the storm abates.
 Snuggets will either gather in groups under a tree canopy or shelter in a nearby cave if they can find one. Sheltering in a cave can often lead to them having to fight whatever is already lurking in the darkness within.


But it doesn’t stop there, and we have tons of different behaviors to add for different situations, including how they interact with each other and you as the new arrival on their island. Feel free to discuss and suggest creature behaviors on our Discord. We love hearing your ideas! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/298a2024630852e38e9ee1089a76807e44b2c578.gif

BASE BUILDING
There are two build modes that can be switched between seamlessly.


 Default mode, for placing solid constructions directly, as long as you have the necessary resources.
 Ghost-building, that allows you to plan and prioritize your base construction through the use of different colors – without spending resources and allows your friends to contribute to the construction as well, by adding the necessary resources.  


What happens when your base gets destroyed?  
Spent hours, days, weeks or even months on building an amazing looking base? Cannot stand the thought of doing all the nitty gritty details again after it was destroyed by another player or creature? Well, this is where ghost-building truly shines and comes in handy. When any elements of the base is destroyed, from the largest pieces to the smallest details, the item will automatically be saved as a ghost element. Then, all you need to do is trigger it, and add the necessary resources again, and boom, your base is back! And since it will be ghost-building, your friends can easily help with the reconstruction process.

Will you be able to share your ideas with others or between worlds?
We plan on eventually making it so that construction blueprints can be saved for later use and be shared with other players. You cannot pack up your base and unpack it again later, but you will be able to make blueprints and reuse these at other locations as part of the ghost building system. Use them to quickly establish a campsite, a small outpost, or even a large base provided there is ample space available for placement.

What kind of limitations can you expect?
There will be very few rules limiting where to build. On the ground, in the trees, inside of caves, even underwater. We won't stop you, although the wildlife might try to. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/a04f97361f403c0c023343baa159c2039d7e193b.gif

UNREAL ENGINE 5 UPDATES
Making Under a Rock requires a powerful game engine, and we are using Unreal Engine 5 with all the latest bells and whistles it has to offer. This includes nanite for infinite view distance, lumen for lighting, groom for creature fur, and with our latest upgrade to UE 5.3 we are now using VSM (Virtual Shadow Maps) which brought the visuals to a whole new level by allowing us to have infinite shadow view distance with a minimum performance impact. In many areas this new wonder from the engine increased the performance across the board, including for our minimum spec target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42511806/bee8a749e4acce639649c5437ef74263cc472d59.jpg

SNEAK PEEK AT WHAT’S TO COME
Looking at what’s coming down the pipeline, we can already see what we want to share with you in future blog posts. This includes showcasing some of the fun and unique items and structures within the game, breaking down what you will be able to do upon release – from fighting  to taming creatures – as well as revealing more of the island's inhabitants including the natives,  but let’s save those details for future posts!

We simply cannot wait to show you more of what we have in store, and if you haven’t already, we would encourage you to Wishlist and Follow us, so you can stay on top of it all. For those who are eager for more up to date information we regularly share screens and short videos on Discord, Instagram and on X, all of which you can find here : linktr.ee/underarock .

Thanks again and see you next time!

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
Studio & Development
Who is making this game?
We are a small indie game studio, Nordic Trolls, consisting of five people.
What is Under a Rock?
Under a Rock is a procedural open-world survival game. Explore your own mysterious and colourful island populated by exotic creatures, oversized wildlife and curious natives, as a 19th century stranded explorer.
Which engine does Under a Rock run on?
Unreal Engine 5

About the Game
When will the game be released?
Currently, we do not have a set release date, but once we do, we will announce it accordingly.
How much will the game cost?
This is still to be determined, but you can expect a reduced price while the game is in Early Access.
On which systems will Under a Rock be available? 
We are currently planning on releasing Under a Rock on PC - both on Windows and Linux -, and consoles.
How many players can play at the same time? Can I play the game as a single player?
Under a Rock supports up to 10 players in co-op, PVP is optional. You also have the option to play the game as a single player, for this you don't need to be online!
What kind of multiplayer modes will be available?
Peer to peer and dedicated servers will be available. For the latter, you have the option of setting up the server on a computer of your choice or renting from a game server provider. Games can be either private or public.
What languages will the game support?
Currently, the game will be available in 11 languages. These are Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish (Spain). As with everything, this may change in the future.
What kind of features can we expect?
	Building bases	Taming and breeding the creatures in the world	Hunting creatures	Fighting other players and in game factions
What survival aspects will be in the game?
	Different weather conditions	Poisonous plants and creatures	Traps scattered across the island	Dangerous nights and unpredictable AI	Hunger & Dehydration - though eating and drinking will not be a huge focus in the game, it will offer bonuses if you keep your health and hydration up.	Resting & Comfort - which will be split into three factors resting, comfort level and a rested bonus and, depending on the circumstance, will give you a number of bonuses.
What will base building look like?
Base building is split into two main categories:
	Real-Time Building - where you gather all the resources and build your base instantly	Ghost Building - which allows you to plan your base ahead of time, and once you have collected all the resources you can build the items.
The Ghost Building is also automatically activated if your base is destroyed, meaning all you have to do is recollect the resources. We also plan on adding a feature that allows you to save your blueprints and share them both between worlds and with friends!
